LESSON: SELF- EXPLORATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Personal development
Topic 1.1: Self- Exploration

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Self- Exploration
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this

• Model B for “appreciate personal awareness in day-to- day life” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

• Model 1: appreciate personal awareness in day-to- day life
